items.title: US and Iran exchange strikes after two US soldiers killed in Jordan
items.description: US forces target Iranian sites for the eighth night in a row, while Iran says it fired drones at the US military in Kuwait.

items.title: Andrew Tate and brother arrested in US after more charges laid against them in UK
items.description: The Crown Prosecution Service says it has requested their extradition from the US, while their lawyer says they are innocent.

items.title: Russia launches major ballistic missile attack on Kyiv
items.description: One death is reported in what President Zelensky calls "one of the most massive ballistic attacks" on Ukraine's capital.

items.title: Cuban dissident Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara goes into exile in US
items.description: He was arrested in 2021 during Cuba's largest anti-government protests in decades and spent five years ⁠in prison.

items.title: New EU border system tripling time at passport control, airport boss says
items.description: Ryanair has also warned passengers travelling to Europe this summer to prepare for extended waits.

items.title: Hungary's president agrees to stand down after parliament backs removal
items.description: Tamás Sulyok, seen as an Orbán loyalist, had until Saturday night to agree to end his term.

items.title: German politician resigns over surrogacy child controversy
items.description: Jens Spahn faced criticism over his use of a surrogate, a ban on which he previously backed.

items.title: Space start-up launches India’s first commercial rocket designed for orbit
items.description: India's first space-tech unicorn Skyroot Aerospace successfully launched Vikram-1 on Saturday.

items.title: Laos says it can't determine cause of  tourist deaths linked to methanol
items.description: Officials say they have no evidence of poisoning over the 2024 deaths because autopsies were not conducted.

items.title: Trump threatens new Canada tariffs over fires sending 'filthy' air into US cities
items.description: Canadian leader Mark Carney says both the US and Canada have an equal responsibility to fight climate change, which experts say are worsening wildfire conditions.

items.title: Indian activist on hunger strike for 20 days forcibly taken to hospital
items.description: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke has now begun an indefinite fast in Sonam Wangchuk's place.

items.title: White House defends Argentina team over Falklands banner
items.description: The comments could further fuel the row over the incident, which has seen Downing Street back calls for Fifa to investigate.
